Leaderboard.eloRule1Body:
• New players (<10 matches): K = 40 (rating changes faster to identify skill level).
• Experienced players (10–30 matches): K = 24.
• Veteran players (>30 matches): K = 16 (more stable ratings).
Leaderboard.eloRule2Body:
• 3-match winning streak: ×1.1 ELO gained.
• 5-match winning streak: ×1.2 ELO.
• 7+ match winning streak: ×1.3 ELO.
• Dominant wins (large set-score margin) receive an additional score-difference multiplier.
Leaderboard.eloRule3Body:
• Beat an opponent rated 200+ ELO higher: +5 ELO bonus.
• Beat an opponent rated 400+ ELO higher: +10 ELO bonus.
Leaderboard.eloRule4Body1: • No official match for 1 continuous month: ratings below 1400 remain unchanged; ratings from 1400 upward decrease by tier each month: 1400–1499 by 2%, 1500–1599 by 3%, 1600–1699 by 4%, and 1700+ by 5%.
Leaderboard.eloRule4Body2: • The ELO shield also applies when decay crosses a protected threshold: the threshold is preserved once, after which the shield expires.
Leaderboard.eloRule4Body3: • Doubles have a separate rating for each pair, initialized at 1000 ELO; individual ELO averages are not used for pair rankings.

SeriesRules.pointsDescription: Each player or team competing in a tournament within the series earns Player Series Rating (PSR) points based on their final ranking. These points are used to rank legs and award wildcard places.
SeriesRules.exclusionIntro: To make the competition more engaging and give every athlete in the community a fair opportunity to compete:
SeriesRules.exclusionRuleOne: Any player or team finishing {threshold} or higher (champion/runner-up) in any tournament immediately receives a direct place in the Finals.
SeriesRules.exclusionRuleTwo: After receiving a direct place, that player or team is locked out of registering for subsequent qualifying tournaments in the current leg.
SeriesRules.wildcardIntro: Players who compete consistently across multiple legs and accumulate a high PSR score, but have not yet earned a direct place (never winning or finishing runner-up), still have a strong opportunity:
SeriesRules.wildcardRuleOne: At the end of the leg, the organizer will review the PSR leaderboard.
SeriesRules.wildcardRuleTwo: The top {count} players or teams with the highest cumulative scores (excluding those who have already earned direct places) will receive wildcards to compete in the national Finals.
SeriesRules.supportDescription: If you have questions about scoring, seeding, or the leg exclusion rule, please contact the organizer through the series contact information.
